item.tib: gshin rje khros pa'i rgyud las gshin rje 'khros byed kyi pho nya sde bzhi'i bskul pa
item.coloph: pho nya sde bzhi'i 'phris/ stag la me 'bar gyis (gyi) pho nya/ rno ngar spu gri dang 'dra ba 'di/ bon dgra bsgral ba'i phyag cha legs so/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i snyan rgyud u ya//
